data.name: [Dated] Singapore Zoo - Tourist Admission with Tram Ride - Direct Entry
data.info:
Includes/Excludes:
Includes:
Singapore Zoo Admission ticket(s)
Tram Ride

Package Description:
[NOTICE] Sealion and Penguin habitats in Singapore Zoo will be undergoing a major revamp and will close from 15 July 2024, with works expected to be completed in 2027 Operating Hours 8:30 to 18.00 Last Admission at 17.00 Identification may be required upon redemption Last tram from Tram Station 1 at 5.30 pm Splash Safari (Approx. 20 mins) @ Shaw Foundation Amphitheatre 10:30am 5:00pm Animal Friends (Approx. 20 mins) @ Rainforest KidzWorld Amphitheatre 1:30pm 4:00pm Into the Wild (Approx. 20 mins) @ Shaw Foundation Amphitheatre 12:00pm 2:30pm Click here to find out more activities line up: https://www.mandai.com/en/singapore-zoo/things-to-do/activities.html What to Bring Wear comfortable walking shoes and light, breathable clothing. Bring sunscreen, a hat, water bottle, and insect repellent for outdoor exploration. Additional Notes Visit early in the morning for cooler weather and active animals. Check show and feeding schedules in advance to plan your route efficiently. Visitors are not allowed to feed the animals without permission from the staff Raincoat or umbrella is recommended during rainy weather. How To Get There By car: Singapore Zoo is about a 30-minute drive from the city. If you’re coming by taxi, there are two convenient drop-off points at the zoo. By train: Khatib, NS14, connect using the Mandai Khatib Shuttle By train: Choa Chu Kang, NS4, connecting bus service 927

Cancellation Policy:
No Cancellation and Non-refundable

Voucher Redemption Period / How To Use:
Show Mobile Ticket: Ticketing counter

Terms & Conditions:
Ticket Eligibility Valid for one entry only. The ticket is valid for foreigners. A child is defined as a person between 3 to 12 years of age for the purpose of determining whether an admission ticket to a Mandai Wildlife Group (MWG) Park is required. Children below 3 years old may enter the Mandai Wildlife Group (MWG) Parks for free, subject to Mandai Wildlife Group (MWG)’ satisfactory verification. A senior is defined as a person at 60 years of age and above for the purpose of determining whether an admission ticket to a Mandai Wildlife Group (MWG) Park is required. Attraction Access This activity is stroller and wheelchair-accessible; however, strollers and wheelchairs must be folded when boarding the tram. Additional Information To increase the supply of taxis to our parks during peak hours, a $5 surcharge is applicable to all hired taxis departing from Mandai Wildlife Reserve from 1:00pm to 11:59pm daily. Free WiFi is available inside the park Important Notes All TA Admission Tickets are subject to WRS Parks’ prevailing “Park Ticket Terms & Conditions” published at https://www.mandai.com/en/park-terms.html. No return, exchange, cancellation, or cash refund is allowed once tickets are issued. Admission is at voucher holder's own risk. WRS will not be responsible for any loss, damage or injury sustained by the voucher holder while in the park Voucher holder agrees not to use photographs/ recording in the park for commercial purposes. WRS may take photographs/recordings of any park visitor for any purpose, without prior approval or compensation; In the event of dispute, WRS electronic records shall prevail; No claims will be entertained for any lost, torn, defaced or expired voucher. Ticket prices and governing conditions are subject to change without notice STB-Licensed Tourist Guide / Tour Leader Complimentary Admission Complimentary Admission Eligibility: 1. STB-Licensed Tourist Guides Tourist guides holding a valid Singapore Tourism Board (STB) Tourist Guide licence are entitled to complimentary admission upon presentation of their valid licence at the point of entry, subject to verification. 2. Tour Leaders One (1) complimentary ticket will be issued for every fifteen (15) paying guests. A maximum of four (4) complimentary tickets may be issued per tour group. Advance Registration Requirements: 3. Complimentary admission for Tour Leaders must be requested in advance. 4. Proof of identity for each Tour Leader and the group booking order must be submitted to the Reservations Team at least three (3) working days before the group's visit date. 5. Complimentary tickets will be issued via the Reseller Portal before the group's arrival. 6. Tour Leaders must present the complimentary ticket at the entrance for admission. Admission Conditions: 7. Admission is subject to verification and approval by the operator. 8. The operator reserves the right to refuse or limit entry if the eligibility requirements are not met. 9. Complimentary Tour Leader tickets are based on a minimum of fifteen (15) paying guests for the same park within a single transaction. Multiple parks or separate transactions cannot be combined for qualification purposes. Exclusions 10. Complimentary admission to Rainforest Wild ASIA does not include access to paid activities under Adventure Plus and Black Adventure. 11. Complimentary admission to River Wonders does not include access to paid activities, including the Amazon River Quest ride.

Package Description:
Singapore Zoo [NOTICE] Sealion and Penguin habitats in Singapore Zoo will be undergoing a major revamp and will close from 15 July 2024, with works expected to be completed in 2027 Operating Hours 8:30 to 18.00 Last Admission at 17.00 Identification may be required upon redemption Last tram from Tram Station 1 at 5.30 pm Splash Safari (Approx. 20 mins) @ Shaw Foundation Amphitheatre 10:30am 5:00pm Animal Friends (Approx. 20 mins) @ Rainforest KidzWorld Amphitheatre 1:30pm 4:00pm Into the Wild (Approx. 20 mins) @ Shaw Foundation Amphitheatre 12:00pm 2:30pm Click here to find out more activities line up: https://www.mandai.com/en/singapore-zoo/things-to-do/activities.html What to Bring Wear comfortable walking shoes and light, breathable clothing. Bring sunscreen, a hat, water bottle, and insect repellent for outdoor exploration. Additional Notes Visit early in the morning for cooler weather and active animals. Check show and feeding schedules in advance to plan your route efficiently. Visitors are not allowed to feed the animals without permission from the staff Raincoat or umbrella is recommended during rainy weather. How To Get There By car: Singapore Zoo is about a 30-minute drive from the city. If you’re coming by taxi, there are two convenient drop-off points at the zoo. By train: Khatib, NS14, connect using the Mandai Khatib Shuttle By train: Choa Chu Kang, NS4, connecting bus service 927 Exploria Discover a new dimension of wildlife exploration at Exploria – Mandai Wildlife Reserve, an immersive indoor experience designed to spark curiosity about the natural world. Located within Mandai Wildlife Reserve, Exploria blends interactive storytelling, multimedia installations, and educational exhibits to bring wildlife conservation and biodiversity to life. Through engaging displays and hands-on activities, visitors can explore fascinating ecosystems, learn about animal habitats, and understand the importance of protecting our planet. The experience is thoughtfully designed for families, students, and nature enthusiasts seeking both fun and meaningful learning. Operating Hours: Mon – Fri: 11:00am – 8:00pm (Last Entry 7:00pm) Sat, Sun & Public Holiday: 11:00am – 9:00pm (Last Entry 8:00pm) With effect from 1 July 2026. The updated operating hours are as follows: Monday to Friday: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Last admission: 7:00 PM) Saturday, Sunday & Public Holidays: 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Last admission: 8:00 PM) The World of Exploria: Extreme Frontiers Infinite Wonderlands Microworlds World of Darkness Realm of the Giants

No Cancellation and Non-refundable

[NOTICE] Sealion and Penguin habitats in Singapore Zoo will be undergoing a major revamp and will close from 15 July 2024, with works expected to be completed in 2027 Operating Hours 8:30 to 18.00 Last Admission at 17.00 Identification may be required upon redemption Last tram from Tram Station 1 at 5.30 pm Splash Safari (Approx. 20 mins) @ Shaw Foundation Amphitheatre 10:30am 5:00pm Animal Friends (Approx. 20 mins) @ Rainforest KidzWorld Amphitheatre 1:30pm 4:00pm Into the Wild (Approx. 20 mins) @ Shaw Foundation Amphitheatre 12:00pm 2:30pm Click here to find out more activities line up: https://www.mandai.com/en/singapore-zoo/things-to-do/activities.html What to Bring Wear comfortable walking shoes and light, breathable clothing. Bring sunscreen, a hat, water bottle, and insect repellent for outdoor exploration. Additional Notes Visit early in the morning for cooler weather and active animals. Check show and feeding schedules in advance to plan your route efficiently. Visitors are not allowed to feed the animals without permission from the staff Raincoat or umbrella is recommended during rainy weather. How To Get There By car: Singapore Zoo is about a 30-minute drive from the city. If you’re coming by taxi, there are two convenient drop-off points at the zoo. By train: Khatib, NS14, connect using the Mandai Khatib Shuttle By train: Choa Chu Kang, NS4, connecting bus service 927

Cancellation Policy:
No Cancellation and Non-refundable

Voucher Redemption Period / How To Use:
Show Mobile Ticket: Ticketing counter
Once you received the ticket, please secure your preferred date and timeslot in advance before visiting our parks from the below link https://reseller.mandai.com/ticketstore/GuestBookTimeslot
Please arrive no later than 45 minutes from above selected time. If the park’s capacity has been reached, you may be required to wait till there is availability
Upon confirmation of date/time via the link, there is no change of timeslot upon e-ticket with barcode being issued.

Terms & Conditions:
Ticket Eligibility A child is defined as a person between 3 to 12 years of age for the purpose of determining whether an admission ticket to a WRS Park is required. Children below 3 years old may enter the WRS Parks for free, subject to WRS’ satisfactory verification. A senior is defined as a person at 60 years of age and above for the purpose of determining whether an admission ticket to a WRS Park is required. Attraction Access This activity is stroller and wheelchair-accessible; however, strollers and wheelchairs must be folded when boarding the tram. Additional Information To increase the supply of taxis to our parks during peak hours, a $5 surcharge is applicable to all hired taxis departing from Mandai Wildlife Reserve from 1:00pm to 11:59pm daily. Free WiFi is available inside the park Important Notes All TA Admission Tickets are subject to WRS Parks’ prevailing “Park Ticket Terms & Conditions” published at https://www.mandai.com/en/park-terms.html. No return, exchange, cancellation, or cash refund is allowed once tickets are issued. Admission is at voucher holder's own risk. WRS will not be responsible for any loss, damage or injury sustained by the voucher holder while in the park Voucher holder agrees not to use photographs/ recording in the park for commercial purposes. WRS may take photographs/recordings of any park visitor for any purpose, without prior approval or compensation; In the event of dispute, WRS electronic records shall prevail; No claims will be entertained for any lost, torn, defaced or expired voucher. Ticket prices and governing conditions are subject to change without notice STB-Licensed Tourist Guide / Tour Leader Complimentary Admission Complimentary Admission Eligibility: 1. STB-Licensed Tourist Guides Tourist guides holding a valid Singapore Tourism Board (STB) Tourist Guide licence are entitled to complimentary admission upon presentation of their valid licence at the point of entry, subject to verification. 2. Tour Leaders One (1) complimentary ticket will be issued for every fifteen (15) paying guests. A maximum of four (4) complimentary tickets may be issued per tour group. Advance Registration Requirements: 3. Complimentary admission for Tour Leaders must be requested in advance. 4. Proof of identity for each Tour Leader and the group booking order must be submitted to the Reservations Team at least three (3) working days before the group's visit date. 5. Complimentary tickets will be issued via the Reseller Portal before the group's arrival. 6. Tour Leaders must present the complimentary ticket at the entrance for admission. Admission Conditions: 7. Admission is subject to verification and approval by the operator. 8. The operator reserves the right to refuse or limit entry if the eligibility requirements are not met. 9. Complimentary Tour Leader tickets are based on a minimum of fifteen (15) paying guests for the same park within a single transaction. Multiple parks or separate transactions cannot be combined for qualification purposes. Exclusions 10. Complimentary admission to Rainforest Wild ASIA does not include access to paid activities under Adventure Plus and Black Adventure. 11. Complimentary admission to River Wonders does not include access to paid activities, including the Amazon River Quest ride.
